goal: Recreate the approved eight-second single-take choreography while preserving the principal subject's identity and the source timing.

reference_assets.name: @Image1
reference_assets.allowed: face, skin, body proportions, hair, makeup, jewelry, and manicure
reference_assets.forbidden: motion, camera, environment, wardrobe changes, and supporting-actor identity

reference_assets.name: @Image2
reference_assets.allowed: features that agree with @Image1 from another angle
reference_assets.forbidden: overriding @Image1 or defining a supporting actor

reference_assets.name: @Video1
reference_assets.allowed: movement, expressions, prop behavior, environment, camera, lighting, timing, and sound
reference_assets.forbidden: performer identity, face, skin, body shape, or hair

reference_assets.name: @Video2
reference_assets.allowed: silhouette motion, subject spacing, camera parallax, and framing continuity
reference_assets.forbidden: identity, hair, skin, wardrobe, color, texture, lighting, props, people, or background appearance

identity_lock: Keep facial proportions, eyes, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, age appearance, and body proportions fixed to @Image1.
Keep hair color, roots, highlights, texture, density, hairline, cut, length, part, bangs, and styling fixed to @Image1.
No face swapping, identity blending, beautification drift, skin-tone change, body reshaping, or hair transformation.
wardrobe_and_props: Use the approved written wardrobe and props without color, construction, coverage, or left/right changes.
subjects_and_relationships: The principal subject keeps @Image1 identity. Any supporting actor is a distinct generated person unless explicitly assigned another identity asset.

stages.action: Begin in the source opening pose and reproduce the first movement beat without a cut.
Continue the central action with the same hand, prop, and subject positions established in stage one.
Complete the final motion and hold the source ending pose through the final frame.

camera_and_lighting: One continuous take. Match source framing, camera movement, perspective, exposure, and lighting continuity.
sound_design: Preserve the supplied dialogue, music, effects, and ambience across the full eight seconds without new speech.
